title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio for Community Facility Uses
previewText: The provisions of Sections 24-13 (Floor Area Bonus for Deep Front and Wide Side Yards) and 33-15 (Floor Area Bonus for Front Yards) shall not apply to any community facility uses located in the Special District.
